notes.title: DragonScales 5 now supports Italian and Portuguese (Brazil) languages
notes.notes: I just updated "DragonScales 5: The Frozen Tomb" with support for Italian and Portuguese (Brazil). No more languages planned for the time being.

notes.title: DragonScales 5: The Frozen Tomb now supports additional languages
notes.notes:
We've just completed localization of "DragonScales 5: The Frozen Tomb" to the following languages:
[list]
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Dutch
[*]Spanish
[/list]

The builds for those languages are already live. Additional languages coming soon.

notes.title: New trailer
notes.notes: We've uploaded a new trailer briefly showcasing battles. Besides the battles in the [b]Colosseum[/b] section, there are 15+ battles in the [b]Adventure[/b] section.
